summary: Frontend-only regression verification on LIVE production (https://www.ayanabott.com + https://api.ayanabott.com) of the axios-timeout fix from iteration 8. Executed a full fresh journey in a clean browser context: signup -> onboarding Step0 (child + dev_code OTP + consent) -> Step1 (Choose Nitya) -> Step2 (add parent Amma / Telugu / nickname Bangaram + schedule) -> Step3 (Activate Care Circle, real Meta WhatsApp send) -> /activation -> dashboard -> refresh -> logout -> re-login -> dashboard. RESULT: 100% PASS. The founder-reported 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' toast NO LONGER appears on any of the 4 mutating wizard steps. Every /api/* call returned 200 and the UI now waits for the real latency instead of aborting. Measured timings: POST /auth/register 4.6s, POST /auth/otp/send 3.8s, /otp/verify 6.1s, PUT /profile/child 4.2s, POST /consent 3.6s, POST /payment/checkout 7.2s (advanced to Step 2 in 7.8s with green toast 'AYANA Nitya selected.'), POST /parents 5.7s + /consent 3.8s + POST /schedules 7.1s (17.1s total, toast 'Parent added!'), POST /activation/activate 17.6s within the 60s override (toast '🎉 Care Circle activated!' + redirect to /activation). Dashboard renders parent 'Amma  mother · Telugu  Known as: Bangaram' proving the JSONB codec returns a real list (no nicknames.map crash, no console errors related to it). Session persisted across hard refresh; logout revoked access to /dashboard (redirect to /login); re-login succeeded in ~2s.

minor.issue: 7.2s response (200). Still far above acceptable; consider warming the asyncpg pool / co-locating Railway with Supabase region.
17.6s (200) — real Meta send, works but user waits with only a spinner.
4.1-6.9s (200); GET /api/checkins?days=7 4.6-5.5s; GET /api/payment/state 5.7-5.9s. Baseline 2.6-2.8s on every GET suggests a fresh DB connection per request.

issues: Save/Activate buttons show only a small spinner for 17s with no progress copy. Users on slow first-write are likely to think it hung and double-click/reload. Recommend inline 'Setting up their care circle — this can take up to 30 seconds…' copy while pending.
Full-page spinner for ~6s while /circle, /checkins, /payment/state resolve serially-ish; skeleton placeholders would be better than a blank page.
Console error: 'X-Frame-Options may only be set via an HTTP header sent along with a document. It may not be set inside <meta>.' — the meta tag is ignored; move it to a Vercel header.

Console error on navigation/reload: 'Failed to load module script: Expected a JavaScript-or-Wasm module script but the server responded with a MIME type of "text/html"' — a module/chunk request is being served the SPA HTML fallback (likely a stale hashed asset after the Vercel redeploy or a rewrite catching /assets/*). Non-blocking in this run but can white-screen returning users mid-deploy.

action_items: No functional action required for the reported bug — axios timeout 30s + 60s activation override + formatAxiosError fully resolve the 'Something went wrong' regression; all 4 wizard steps advance.
Reduce backend write latency (pool warm-up / region co-location); 7-18s writes are the real remaining UX risk.
Add pending-state copy on save-parent and activate buttons (17s waits).
Fix Vercel asset rewrite/MIME fallback for module chunks and move X-Frame-Options from <meta> to an HTTP header.
critical_code_review_comments: formatAxiosError falls through to formatApiError(error.response?.data?.detail) when error.response is undefined and it is not a timeout/network error — that path always yields the generic 'Something went wrong'. Low risk but consider logging error.code there for diagnosability.

Onboarding.js is 466 lines with 4 sequential awaits inside saveParentForm (parents -> consent -> schedules). If the schedule POST fails after the parent POST succeeds, the UI keeps the parent in state but no schedule exists and the user retries, creating duplicate schedules (test_credentials.md already notes duplicates from the pre-fix retry loop). Consider a single transactional backend endpoint or idempotency key.

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 8 RCA confirmed correct: axios timeout was 6000ms while production writes take 7-18s, so the client aborted requests the server had already committed and formatApiError(undefined) rendered 'Something went wrong'. With timeout=30000 globally, a 60000 override on /activation/activate, and formatAxiosError distinguishing ECONNABORTED/network/server errors, all four mutating steps now complete and advance correctly. No new frontend bug found; the only remaining risk is the underlying 7-18s backend write latency, which is a performance (not correctness) issue.
